title: Auto-mode HIL proxy gate fails stage 0: human agent invoked without the product brief / artifacts
body: Auto-mode HIL proxy gate rejects stage 0 (and every gate): the human agent is invoked without the product brief or the artifacts under review. Evidence: core/human_proxy.py:103-107 builds a generic task and ignores the artifacts arg (reads only the human agent own outputs); core/pipeline_executor.py:1087-1103 uses the proxy decision before the auto_approve short-circuit. Observed on e2e run MyToDo: ideation produced a grounded ideation-output quoting the brief, but the human gate returned changes with reasons No brief present / only the product name is available, twice -> agent needs_retry -> stage 0 FAILED.

rcca.root_cause: human_proxy.decide() builds a generic gate task and ignores the artifacts argument; the product brief (executor.project_idea) is never passed to the human agent, so in auto mode the gate cannot judge and fails closed. The proxy decision also precedes the auto_approve short-circuit, so --auto cannot override it.
rcca.corrective: Pass the product brief and the artifacts under review into the human-proxy gate task so the auto-mode human agent can judge; keep fail-closed only for genuinely missing context.
rcca.preventive: Add a test: auto mode with a valid brief approves stage 0 (proxy sees the brief); assert the proxy prompt contains the brief + artifact.
